answer: Each agent must refract a prism of identity: the beacon emits a gale-force pulse each epoch, and the agent must anchor a unique zephyr-signature to the chain. The first prism facet costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent facet doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at facet 14 (20.4 M iterations). A zephyr audit verifies each facet against the epoch gale; any missing facet voids the spectrum. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full prism cost because each facet binds to the unique identity key—no shared spectrum possible.
